title: Read-only sed checker refuses a bracket expression with a repeated leading caret ([^^]), which master allowed
outcome: claude_sed_bracket_end consumes at most one leading negation caret, so `[^^]` and `[^]]` parse as sed parses them. `sed -n '/[^^]/p' f` and `sed 's/[^^]/x/g' f` are accepted again on all four read-only paths, with positive tests that also keep `[^]]`.
acceptance: Read-only sed checker refuses a bracket expression with a repeated leading caret ([^^]), which master allowed is done
